items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Out there making a picture with Mae West, 'Belle of the Nineties,' maybe you seen it.

ctx.x: Now, all American actors, the Palace Theatre, all them bigtime celebrity actors, the Palace Theatre was heaven, that was their heaven. We played it, first band to play it. (Laughter) Had the Marx Brothers on the bill. And they was the headliners and we were closing the first -- the act was in two segments, you know. Man, we tore the thing so bad and he's supposed to open up the second half. Died like a dog. We tore them up, So he come off and he conned Duke, the Marx Brothers, Groucho and his brothers. He was a…

So Duke don't ask him about no money. Duke say all right, so we give him a lift. Closing night that cat didn't say nothing. 'Thank you, guys,' and didn't say nothing about no money. So that's all right, so we went to California to make a picture. Out there making a picture with Mae West, 'Belle of the Nineties,' maybe you seen it. And we had to make another picture, 'Murder at the Vanities,' and they were on the lot, so this cat come around, 'Man, I know Duke and them, they played with me in the Palace in New…
So he happened to say it, and I said, yeah, --
